uncertainty_combination.coverage: approximately one standard deviation of the stated error sources; it does not cover a systematic DFT bias of unknown sign common to both saddles beyond the 1.0 kcal/mol allowance
uncertainty_combination.dependence: assumed independent; the two measured terms come from disjoint perturbations and the two asserted terms from disjoint model axes, so any positive correlation would make this total an underestimate
uncertainty_combination.input_meaning: Two measured spreads (geometry convergence, entropy model) and two asserted allowances (functional/basis, conformer-and-environment model), each treated as a 1-sigma half-width on the delivered difference.

uncertainty_components.meaning: Residual geometry-convergence term on the ester-at-C4 saddle: |G(converged restart) - G(cycle-2 unconverged structure)| at 353 K, both at the identical level.
Vibrational-entropy model term: shift in the regio-difference on replacing harmonic RRHO with Grimme quasi-RRHO (100 cm^-1 cutoff, alpha 4) on both saddles.

Functional and basis-set term: B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP error on a difference of two asynchronous cycloaddition barriers. Not measurable in this envelope; a second functional or a def2-TZVP single-point pair would measure it and neither was affordable alongside guaranteed delivery.

Model term: one saddle conformer per channel (no benzyl, methoxycarbonyl or CF3 rotamer sampling) and a gas-phase treatment of a reaction run neat. Folded into one allowance because neither axis was sampled.
